sentences.en: It's really unfortunate. You don't understand at all its essence.
sentences.zh: 你完全不明白它的本质。

sentences.en: Only the surface of things reveals the essence of things.
sentences.zh: 事物的本质只有通过表面才能显现出来。

sentences.en: What do you think is the essence of the training?
sentences.zh: 你觉得训练的本质是什么？

senses.zh: 本质，要素；精华，精髓；香精，精油
